stations.title: Bakehouse database
stations.text: One row per order, and many orders.
stations.note: A list of rows is not a number.

captions: Odile liked the lists. Now she starts each Monday asking how many orders are pending.
A query can list every order, but then someone counts the rows by hand.
You write queries that fold rows into summaries, in three tasks.
Now your query gives one line per status, already counted.
Same orders, a number instead of a list. Groups do the counting.
